summary: All 8 files in the unit contain formal mathematical content relevant to search. HexLLLTheory.lean is the main module with public imports and a library docstring. Checker.lean proves soundness of executable reducedness checkers (lllReduced_sound, lllReducedCheck_sound, certCheck_sound). IntegerLattice.lean defines the integer row lattice as Submodule ℤ and proves equivalence with Hex.Matrix.memLattice, plus Euclidean embeddings and the conditional short-vector bound. Interval.lean (largest at 45KB) contains the full soundness proof for the fixed-precision interval checker lllReducedInterval_sound with interval arithmetic containment lemmas and Gram-Schmidt recurrence proofs. Reduction.lean states the public correctness theorems for lllNative and lll (isLLLReduced, memLattice_iff, independent, short_vector). ReductionInvariant.lean (largest at 113KB) develops the loop invariants: Valid/independence preservation for swapStep/sizeReduce, potential strict-decrease, fuel sufficiency, and prefixLLLReduced induction. ShortVector.lean discharges the Euclidean short-vector bounds for lllNative and lll. State.lean proves LLLState.ofBasis_valid, the scaled-coefficient correspondence lllState_ν_eq_coeffs, and the integer↔rational Lovász equivalence. No file is pure navigation-only without mathematical content; the import aggregator also serves as the library's documented entry point.
